newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian stock markets closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian stock markets closed for holiday.

text.p: Major Indian stock markets, except Madras were closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival. They will reopen Thursday, and close for a Moslem festival on Friday.
The Bombay Stock Exchange top 30 index closed on Tuesday up 52.72, or 1.61 percent, at 3,647.44.
The National index rose 13.15 points to 1,016.40.
Delhi index closed up 7.58 points at 760.63, Calcutta index was up 1.06 at 100.81
Madras index closed 11.08 points up at 3,481.90
